script_text: Stop! Mars is making a rare alignment that demands your attention, Aries. Today, your ruling planet Mars forms a dynamic square with Jupiter in your 10th House of Career, creating a powerful but potentially explosive energy. This aspect indicates sudden opportunities that may require bold action but also carry risks. Venus enters your 7th House of Partnerships, bringing harmony to existing relationships but also attracting attention from admirers who may challenge your current commitments. The Moon sextile Uranus in your 2nd House of Finances suggests an unexpected financial opportunity could arise through a creative project or innovative approach. Beware of impulsive decisions regarding investments—your natural Aries enthusiasm could override practical judgment. Subscribe for tomorrow's reading when Mercury retrograde begins to impact your communications.
